auth.brandHeadline: All of your team's work and goals in one place
auth.brandPoint1: Tasks and projects that follow your org chart
auth.brandPoint2: Goals and performance tied to daily work
auth.brandPoint3: Fine-grained permissions and an audit trail for every action

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter your work email and password to reach your workspace.
login.inviteOnly: Sign-in is by invitation only. No account? Ask your workspace admin to invite you.
login.footer: You can end your sessions on any device from your account settings.
login.invalid: Wrong email or password. After 5 failed attempts sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.
login.noAccess: Your account isn't linked to an active workspace. Contact your workspace admin.

locked.title: Sign-in paused for now
locked.body: A wrong password was entered 5 times for this account. To protect it, you can try again in:
locked.hint: If this wasn't you, let your workspace admin know.

twoFactor.title: Enter your verification code
twoFactor.subtitle: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit code shown for TRend.
twoFactor.backupSubtitle: One of the backup codes you saved when turning on two-factor authentication. Each code works once.
twoFactor.invalid: The code is wrong or has expired.
twoFactor.expired: Verification timed out. Please sign in again.

setupMfa.title: Turn on two-factor authentication to continue
setupMfa.subtitle: Because your account has admin permissions, we ask for a code from your phone at every sign-in. Setup takes a minute.
setupMfa.step1Body: Such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
setupMfa.step2Title: Scan the code or enter the key manually
setupMfa.qrLabel: QR code to add TRend to your authenticator app
setupMfa.step3Title: Enter the code shown in the app
setupMfa.backupBody: Use one if you lose your phone. Each code works once, and we won't show them again.

invite.title: Welcome to TRend
invite.subtitle: Choose a password to activate your account.
invite.note: This link works once. If it has expired, ask your admin to send it again.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, expired or already used.
invite.existingAccount: This email already has a TRend account. Enter its current password to add the workspace to it.
invite.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

gate.offline: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
